note: 术语定义以行业通用用法为主（sourceIds 为空表示通用行业术语，无单一权威归属）。涉及标准机构用语时标注 sourceId。日文只在有把握的标准用法下提供，否则为 null。

definition.zh-Hans: 手冲开头用少量热水润湿咖啡粉、让粉层排气并膨胀的步骤。官方 V60 指南给约 30 秒；AeroPress 官方给 30–60 秒。
definition.en: The initial small pour that wets the grounds and lets the bed degas and expand. Hario's official guide uses about 30 seconds; AeroPress's official guide uses 30–60 seconds.

definition.zh-Hans: 注水结束后，水从粉层完全流下的阶段；时长受研磨与细粉影响。
definition.en: The phase after pouring stops, in which water drains fully from the bed; its duration depends on grind and fines.

definition.zh-Hans: 水绕过咖啡粉、未参与萃取而直接进入杯中，导致浓度降低。
definition.en: Water that flows around the coffee bed without extracting, diluting the cup.

definition.zh-Hans: 咖啡液中溶解物质的浓度指标；UC Davis 的冷萃研究用 TDS 作为量化指标之一。
definition.en: A measure of dissolved solids in the brewed liquid; UC Davis's cold brew study used TDS as one of its quantitative measures.

definition.zh-Hans: 被萃取出的咖啡物质占咖啡粉干重的百分比。
definition.en: The percentage of the dry coffee mass that has been extracted into the beverage.

definition.zh-Hans: 咖啡粉与水的重量比。例：Hario V60 官方 15g:250g（约 1:16.7）；AeroPress 官方 espresso 风格为浓缩液。
definition.en: The weight ratio of coffee to water. E.g. Hario's official V60 guide uses 15g coffee to 250g water (about 1:16.7).

definition.zh-Hans: 一次冲煮投入的咖啡粉重量。V60 官方 15g；意式常见 18g；Linea Micra 推荐 14/17/21g 滤杯。
definition.en: The weight of coffee used for one brew. Hario's V60 guide uses 15g; espresso commonly 18g; Linea Micra recommends 14/17/21g baskets.

definition.zh-Hans: 意式出品液体的重量。La Marzocco 官方称出液应约为粉重两倍；Fellow 配方有 18g→36g（1:2）与 18g→55g（1:3）。
definition.en: The weight of the espresso liquid produced. La Marzocco states it should be about twice the dose; Fellow's recipes include 18g→36g (1:2) and 18g→55g (1:3).

definition.zh-Hans: 水在粉饼中形成优先通道，导致局部过萃与整体不均。
definition.en: Water forming preferential paths through the puck, causing local over-extraction and overall unevenness.

definition.zh-Hans: 意式萃取后留在滤杯里的压实的咖啡粉块。
definition.en: The compressed disc of spent coffee left in the basket after an espresso shot.

definition.zh-Hans: 承载滤杯（basket）并锁入冲煮头的部件。Rancilio Silvia 用 58mm 手柄。
definition.en: The handle that holds the basket and locks into the group head. Rancilio Silvia uses a 58mm portafilter.

definition.zh-Hans: 装粉的金属碗。分单/双份、加压（双壁）与精密滤杯。Linea Micra 官方推荐 14g 做意式、17/21g 做主 flow espresso。
definition.en: The metal bowl that holds the grounds. Comes in single/double and pressurised (double-wall) vs precision types. Linea Micra documents 14g for Italian-style and 17/21g for mainstream espresso.

definition.zh-Hans: 限制冲煮压力上限的阀门。定义属行业通用，本知识库未取得厂商/标准来源对其在具体机型上的说明。
definition.en: A valve that caps brew pressure. The term is industry-standard; this knowledge base has no manufacturer/standards source describing it for a specific model yet.

definition.zh-Hans: 比例-积分-微分温度控制。La Marzocco Linea Mini 产品页描述其具备 PID 控制与阶梯式温度轮。
definition.en: Proportional-integral-derivative temperature control. La Marzocco's Linea Mini product page describes PID control with a stepped temperature wheel.

terms.ja: プリインフュージョン

definition.zh-Hans: 主萃取前以较低压力/流量先润湿粉饼。Linea Mini 拨杆带电子预浸泡；Fellow 配方用 5 秒 / 3 bar 预浸。
definition.en: Wetting the puck at lower pressure/flow before the main extraction. The Linea Mini paddle offers electronic pre-infusion; a Fellow recipe uses 5s at 3 bar.

definition.zh-Hans: 用盲碗/清洗片让水流反向冲刷冲煮头的清洁动作。Sage BES875 的 CLEAN ME 循环即 backflush，约 5 分钟，与除垢是两件事。
definition.en: Cleaning the group head by forcing water backwards with a blind basket/cleaning disc. The Sage BES875 CLEAN ME cycle is a backflush, about 5 minutes, and is separate from descaling.

terms.ja: 脱スケール / 洗浄（クエン酸）

definition.zh-Hans: 去除锅炉/管路内水垢。周期随机型与水硬度差异极大（Gaggia Classic 每 2 个月；Nespresso 每 600 粒或 6 个月；Saeco 用 AquaClean 时最长 5000 杯）。
definition.en: Removing scale from the boiler and water paths. Intervals vary widely by model and water hardness (Gaggia Classic every 2 months; Nespresso every 600 capsules or 6 months; Saeco with AquaClean up to 5000 cups).

definition.zh-Hans: 烘焙后到风味峰值之间的静置期。厂商配方语境的实例从深烘 5–7 天到浅烘/实验处理 4–6 周不等。
definition.en: The rest between roast day and peak flavour. In manufacturer recipe context, examples range from 5–7 days for a dark roast to 4–6 weeks for a light, experimental-process coffee.

definition.zh-Hans: 烘焙后咖啡持续释放二氧化碳的过程，会干扰均匀萃取。
definition.en: The ongoing release of carbon dioxide after roasting, which interferes with even extraction.

definition.zh-Hans: 标准化评价咖啡的协议。当前 SCA 使用 CVA（取代 2004 协议），CQI 继续使用 2004 form。
definition.en: A standardised protocol for evaluating coffee. SCA now uses CVA (superseding the 2004 protocol) while CQI continues to use the 2004 form.

definition.zh-Hans: 去除果肉后再发酵、水洗的处理法族。CQI 的处理教育覆盖 natural / honey / washed / wet hulled。
definition.en: A processing family where the fruit is removed before fermentation and washing. CQI's processing education covers natural, honey, washed and wet hulled.

definition.zh-Hans: 整颗果实干燥的处理法。
definition.en: Processing in which the whole fruit is dried.

definition.zh-Hans: 保留部分果胶的处理法。
definition.en: Processing that retains part of the mucilage.

definition.zh-Hans: 印尼式处理法，在果胶仍在时脱壳。CQI 处理课程覆盖 wet hulled。
definition.en: An Indonesian method that removes the parchment while the mucilage is still present. CQI's processing course covers wet hulled.

definition.zh-Hans: 在缺氧环境中进行的发酵。具体机制请见 fermentation 文档（当前为 skeleton，未取得可引用来源）。
definition.en: Fermentation in a low-oxygen environment. See the fermentation document (currently a skeleton — no citable source obtained yet).

definition.zh-Hans: 磨豆机的研磨刀盘。Comandante C40 Mk4 使用七边形锥刀（Nitro Blade）。
definition.en: The cutting element of a grinder. The Comandante C40 Mk4 uses a heptagonal conical burr (Nitro Blade).

definition.zh-Hans: 锥形刀盘。Baratza 的 Encore/Sette/Virtuoso 为锥刀。
definition.en: A cone-shaped burr set. Baratza's Encore/Sette/Virtuoso are conical.

definition.zh-Hans: 平面刀盘。Baratza Forte BG 为平钢刀（冲煮磨）。
definition.en: A flat burr set. Baratza's Forte BG is a flat steel burr brew grinder.

definition.zh-Hans: 研磨中产生的过细颗粒，会堵塞滤纸、降低均匀度。AeroPress 官方称纸微滤可消除细粉带来的颗粒感。
definition.en: Over-fine particles produced during grinding, which can clog filters and reduce evenness. AeroPress notes its paper micro-filter removes fines for a smoother cup.

definition.zh-Hans: 磨豆机内部滞留的咖啡粉量。Baratza 提供爆炸图以便维护相关部件。
definition.en: Coffee left inside the grinder after grinding. Baratza publishes exploded parts diagrams for servicing related components.

definition.zh-Hans: 用手柄式压粉器把粉压成水平粉床。Fellow 官方建议以 90° 手臂角度填压。
definition.en: Pressing the grounds into a level bed with a tamper. Fellow's official guide recommends a 90-degree arm angle.

definition.zh-Hans: 意式表面的泡沫层。Gaggia 故障排除将「几乎无 crema」归因于粉太粗/未填压/豆太老。
definition.en: The foam layer on espresso. Gaggia's troubleshooting attributes 'little crema' to coarse grind, no tamping, or old/dry beans.

definition.zh-Hans: 打发牛奶形成的细密泡沫。Fellow 官方给可操作判据：冷奶开始、蒸汽嘴 45°、撕纸声、形成漩涡。
definition.en: The fine foam produced by steaming milk. Fellow's official guide gives operational cues: start cold, wand at 45°, a paper-tearing sound, a rolling vortex.

definition.zh-Hans: Hario 的锥形滤杯（60° 夹角）。官方配方与产地见对应文档。
definition.en: Hario's cone-shaped dripper (60-degree wall). See the pour-over document for official recipes.

definition.zh-Hans: 平底 + 三孔滤杯，配波纹滤纸形成空气层。
definition.en: A flat-bottom, three-hole dripper whose wavy filter forms an insulating air layer.

definition.zh-Hans: 浸泡 + 加压式冲煮器。官方基准 85°C、中细研磨、30–60 秒浸泡。
definition.en: An immersion-plus-pressure brewer. Official baseline: 85°C, medium-fine grind, 30–60 seconds steep.

definition.zh-Hans: 细长壶嘴、便于控制水流的手冲壶。Hario Buono 为其一例。
definition.en: A kettle with a narrow, curved spout for controlled pouring. The Hario Buono is one example.

definition.zh-Hans: 烘焙后颜色偏浅的未熟豆。定义属行业通用；本知识库未取得权威定义来源。
definition.en: An under-ripe bean that stays pale after roasting. The term is industry-standard; no authoritative definition source has been obtained yet.

definition.zh-Hans: 用细针在粉碗内搅拌以打散结块的布粉技巧。本知识库未取得对其效果的来源。
definition.en: A distribution technique using fine needles to break up clumps in the basket. No source for its effect has been obtained here.

definition.zh-Hans: 放在粉饼上方的金属滤网。本知识库未取得对其效果的来源。
definition.en: A metal screen placed on top of the puck. No source for its effect has been obtained here.

terms.ja: ノンポルタフィルター

definition.zh-Hans: 底部开口、可直接观察萃取的手柄。
definition.en: A portafilter with an open bottom that lets you watch the extraction directly.

terms.ja: コーヒーテイスターズフレーバーホイール

definition.zh-Hans: SCA 与 WCR 于 2016 联合更新，基础为 WCR Sensory Lexicon（110 个属性）。许可为 CC BY-NC-ND 4.0：可展示分享，不得改编或商用。
definition.en: Updated by SCA and WCR in 2016, built on the WCR Sensory Lexicon (110 attributes). Licensed CC BY-NC-ND 4.0: display and share allowed, adaptation and commercial use not.

definition.zh-Hans: CQI 用于杯测训练与校准的水溶液风味标准。Q 考试包含对其的识别与回忆。
definition.en: Aqueous flavour standards used by CQI for cupping training and calibration; the Q exams include recognising and recalling them.

definition.zh-Hans: SCA 的评价体系，分 Physical / Descriptive / Affective / Extrinsic 四部分，2024 起成为官方杯测标准。
definition.en: SCA's evaluation system with Physical / Descriptive / Affective / Extrinsic components; official cupping standard since 2024.

definition.zh-Hans: 冲煮中对粉层施加的扰动。AeroPress 官方流程含轻搅 3 秒；V60 署名配方含末段双向小搅动。
definition.en: Disturbance applied to the coffee bed. The official AeroPress steps include a 3-second stir; a signed V60 recipe includes a final two-way stir.

definition.zh-Hans: 见 wet hulled。
definition.en: See wet hulled.

definition.zh-Hans: 衡量烘焙度的色值体系。UC Davis 冷萃研究用 Agtron 41.8（浅）与 71.8（中深）标定两组样品。
definition.en: A colour-scale system for roast level. UC Davis's cold brew study used Agtron 41.8 (light) and 71.8 (medium-dark) to define its two blends.
